name: Collapsing Ceiling (1-2) OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-03: Escaping the Grave
description: The damaged ceiling is the only thing stopping the centipedes lairing above from falling through.
disable: DC 19 Crafting (trained) to reinforce the ceiling with boards from the broken door.

generalAbilities.name: Collapse
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature walks into the area beneath the centipede lair.

Effect Hearing potential prey, the centipedes begin scrabbling above, causing the ceiling to collapse and centipedes to rain down, dealing (2d6+3) Bludgeoning Damage damage to each creature in the area; each creature in the area must attempt a DC 16 Reflex Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is knocked Prone.
